result.summary: The page layout is largely coherent, but there are two notable inconsistencies: the bottom navigation highlights the wrong tab for the currently displayed home feed, and the favorite (heart) buttons on the 'Popular right now' cards use two different visual styles. A minor image-background inconsistency appears in the 'Fastest near you' carousel.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar highlights 'Profile' (green icon and label) as the active tab, but the content shown is the home/discovery feed (address bar, search, promo banner, restaurant carousels). The active state does not match the visible screen.
issues.suggestion: Set the active navigation state to 'Home' when the home feed is displayed, and ensure the selected tab is driven by the current route.

issues.description: The favorite heart buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards are styled inconsistently: the first card uses a white circle with a dark outlined heart, while the second uses a dark circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Use a single consistent favorite-button style (same background, icon color, and size) across all restaurant cards, reserving a distinct style only for the filled/favorited state.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail has a light grey background while the neighbouring thumbnails use dark backgrounds, making the row look visually uneven and the white time badge on it lower contrast.
issues.suggestion: Normalise card image backgrounds (or apply a consistent overlay/gradient) so all carousel thumbnails share the same tone and the white time badge remains legible.
